title: Gray Cardigan & Polka Dot Skirt
prompt: An original young woman with dark hair pulled back at the nape stands in a full-length pose. She wears a fitted gray cardigan with a fitted peplum hem over a pale blue blouse with a ruffled collar and a tied bow at the neck. A pale blue A-line midi skirt with small black dots, a black crossbody bag, and gray knee socks with black buckled loafers complete the look. Her expression is calm and composed. Soft, warm studio light against a beige wall. Palette of gray, powder blue, and black. Soft and polished, in the style of a preppy spring catalog.
workingNotes:
- The bow collar and polka dot skirt are the signature details.
- Keep the beige wall for a soft, neutral backdrop.
